title: IERP Tenant Context
description: Schema for IERP Temporary Tenant Context (TTC) — optional aggregation layer on top of Task/Lease.

tenant_uuid.description: Globally unique TTC identifier (UUID v7, RFC 9562). Time-ordered, 48-bit ms timestamp + 74 random bits.

internal_id.description: Instance-local unique identifier. 14-char alphanumeric, CSPRNG-generated. Used for fast local lookup and human-readable references.

lease_type.description: Classifies the type of resource being temporarily borrowed.

ttl_seconds.description: Maximum lifetime of the TTC context in seconds.

task_ids.description: List of Task IDs correlated under this TTC.
